intents.name: OS Update / Performance Issues
intents.description: Issues related to slow performance, freezing, or bugs after an iOS update.
positive_examples: I just updated my phone and suddenly everything takes ages to load
after the 11.0.2 my phone just sucks
inclusion_rules: Include any complaints about device speed, freezing, or general bugs specifically tied to an OS update.
exclusion_rules: Exclude issues strictly about battery life without mentioning update performance.
intents.confidence_notes: If the user mentions an update AND battery drain, prioritize battery drain.

intents.name: Battery Drain
intents.description: Complaints about the battery dying too quickly or draining fast.
positive_examples: used my phone for 2 minutes and it drains it down 8 percent
negative_examples: phone is dead and won't turn on
inclusion_rules: Include all complaints about fast power loss or poor battery health.
exclusion_rules: Exclude devices that will not charge due to hardware defects.
intents.confidence_notes: Often co-occurs with OS updates. Tag as battery drain if battery is the primary complaint.

intents.name: App Compatibility / Usage Issues
intents.description: Specific apps crashing, not working together, or broken functionality within the OS.
positive_examples: does not let me listen to music and go on whatsapp at the same time
most of the apps are broken, wifi disconnects frequently
inclusion_rules: Include mentions of specific apps failing to open or conflicting.
exclusion_rules: Exclude third-party app issues if they are completely unrelated to Apple's OS.
intents.confidence_notes: Look for specific app names or functional bugs.

intents.name: Account & Authentication
intents.description: Issues with receiving codes, logging in, or Apple ID.
positive_examples: I need a new code for my I-store
haven’t recd any but msg is too many sent
inclusion_rules: Include 2FA issues, locked accounts, and store login failures.
exclusion_rules: Exclude basic password resets where a self-service link exists.
intents.confidence_notes: Account issues often require secure human verification.

intents.name: Other / Unclear
intents.description: Messages that do not fit into any other intent, lack context, or are not support-related.
inclusion_rules: Include general feedback, gibberish, or queries outside the support scope.
exclusion_rules: Do not use if a specific intent is partially applicable.
